title: Advanced user returning after 10 months — knowledge ≠ capacity

expectations.assert: legacy: classed 'returning' (long layoff ∧ real prior volume)
QAE three-axis: trainingKnowledge=advanced; recentTrainingExposure={none/sporadic, 10 months}; currentWorkCapacity=reduced band, conservative confidence — axes NEVER collapsed ([CTO-QAE-001] §12)
PARITY: reduced starting volume (legacy: returning volume class 9 sets vs advanced 16; deload −1 set applied for returning consistency)
advanced terminology and exercise vocabulary retained (knowledge axis); no beginner-jargon suppression
ramp plan attached: weekly capacity restoration gated on completion + recovery; detraining evidence supports starting well below prior workload
early reviews: ramp increments are cooldown-gated volume changes inside ChangeBudget; early ramp-exit only on sustained evidence
decision space caps early volume increases regardless of user enthusiasm
